adversarial_lines.detail: Fully preserved with both the challenge and its outcome. Seattle (L1.1) = the real leading US negative, but on the HOURS/hiring margin and contested (EPI critique; incumbents ~break even). L2.1 monopsony alone can't explain full pass-through + non-falling profits. L3.1 pass-through is necessary-not-sufficient (competitive model also predicts it; predicts job loss unless output demand inelastic). L4.1 automation null in fast food (Ashenfelter-Jurajda) BUT Lordan-Neumark shows real automation-substitution losses for older/low-skilled/manufacturing — captured as genuine contradiction (composition shifts hide within-group losses). L6 is a full red-team of the 'zero' hypothesis (Neumark-Shirley preponderance negative) with explicit reconciliation. Adversarial verdicts and confidence are recorded.
